description: The changemaker attributes returned only to callers that hold `view` permission on the changemaker. Every other caller, including unauthenticated ones, receives a response with these attributes absent rather than null.

keycloakOrganizationId.description: Optional, set this only when available. One can PATCH it in later if it becomes available.

createdBy.description: The keycloak user id of the PDC user that created this changemaker
